summary: A local, static, dependency-free, read-only, pre-P3 M0 Flight Readiness review surface renders seven fixture-class FlightReadinessPacket projections, every one emitted by the accepted M0 package rather than hand-authored. The first screen carries the stored analysis_use, the separately labelled derived post_analysis_eligibility, why the Flight is limited, and the typed next safe action; the exact source-read and D4/D6 recomputation receipts open in one keyboard interaction. Verification was re-executed end to end by a second audit session against the final bytes: 16 of 16 build-test commands passed with none skipped, covering 46 mechanical checks, 22 behaviour tests, 120 layout measurements, five PYTHONHASHSEED values, and clean runs from the repository root and an unrelated working directory. Twelve captures at desktop and 390px were read by the implementing session and independently decoded by the audit session. This is a local fixture artifact ready for independent exact-byte review and nothing broader.

sessions.note: The two sessions overlapped between 23:15 and 23:24 on 2026-08-19, during which the implementing session was still writing into both owned roots and published a terminal status. The audit session halted rather than racing it; the Owner then confirmed the implementing session was stopped and no writers remained. Byte stability was re-established by two identical full-tree hashes of all 39 non-transient owned files at 23:34:28 and 23:39:19 before any correction was written.

output_binding.recipe: sha256 over the concatenation of '<sha256>  <repository-relative-path>\n' lines, ascending by path, for every file under prototypes/m0-flight-readiness-review/ and docs/reviews/2026-08-18-m0-flight-readiness-review-surface/, excluding __pycache__, .pytest_cache, .omc, .chrome-profile and .DS_Store, and excluding the two self-referential outputs evidence-receipt.md and status.json
